description: ShellExView - list every shell extension installed on the system and disable the ones that misbehave
notes: The app auto-elevates: every launch raises a UAC prompt, because disabling an extension writes outside HKCU.
Settings go to shexview.cfg next to the exe - pre-created as an empty file so scoop persists it as a file, not a directory junction.
A translation file (shexview.exe /savelangfile writes shexview_lng.ini) is deliberately not persisted: an empty placeholder would be loaded as an empty translation and blank out the UI.
The download URLs carry no version, so checkver watches the PAD manifest and every version bump re-hashes the same two zips.
